name: System Architecture & Roadmap Plan Contract
description: Master prompt structure for architectural roadmaps, migrations, and phased technical initiatives.

required_sections.heading: Role & Strategic Technical Persona
required_sections.description: Enterprise architect / technical roadmap lead persona.

required_sections.heading: Strategic Initiative Objective & Phased Scope
required_sections.description: Primary transformational outcomes and target state.

required_sections.heading: Phase-by-Phase Execution Roadmap
required_sections.description: Sequential phases with entry gates, work streams, and deliverables.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Milestone Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Quantitative exit criteria for each roadmap phase.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Phase tables, work breakdown structures, and milestones.

required_sections.heading: Self-Verification Quality Checklist
required_sections.description: Verification of dependencies, rollback contingencies, and critical path.

required_sections.heading: Planning Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits undefined resource dependencies and unversioned targets.

required_sections.heading: Documented Planning Assumptions & Baseline
required_sections.description: Assumed organizational velocity, tooling, and team structure.

exemplars.pattern: Break down into ordered phases with hard exit criteria, dependency DAGs, rollback contingencies, and risk mitigation buffers.
